source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Okay, let’s use this design. It still preserves the DJ Turntables vibe. The pour spout should face the baristas, and I want the buttons to work and be functional. Let’s also make it as splash-free as possible. Keep the existing words on the machine, along with the green accents. The sole wording change is that it should read "[CLIENT_NAME_001]'s Matcha Mixer". I like the machine’s thickness in the side view. I want deep matcha wells without making the box overly large.

value_updates.form_factor: Use the selected design's side-view thickness while accommodating deep matcha wells without making the enclosure overly large.
